title: Experts disagree on this request
context:
Chief architect: This pins the scope shut and matches the request's guardrail and the design's out-of-scope list. Whether to split the leak fix from the redesign is a sequencing choice only the owner can make, so it is asked as its own question rather than settled here.

Target: this request
- solution-architect: out of scope: instruments for other workflows, any change to what a gate decides, any hook stdout or decision, hooks.json and the settings golden, /paqad subcommands other than show, graph-ui; tests/e2e/stage-enforcement-contract.e2e.test.ts passes unedited
- solution-architect: the change spans engine (src/hud, src/feature-evidence, src/cost, src/delivery, src/pipeline), one SessionStart hook and the mod; a single PR is large, and splitting engine scoping (the critical leak) from the band and Ledger redesign would let the leak fix ship first
